home.title: Quiet luxury. Ready to be yours.
home.slogan: At VIOLET, beauty is meant to be effortless. Our collections are crafted to simplify the design  experience — pre-curated, perfectly balanced, and ready to be made yours.

slider.connectSlogan: We’re always open to thoughtful collaborations that share our values of design and refinement.
slider.websiteSlogan: Explore our semi-custom collections of monograms, stationery & wedding websites.

footerNor.privacy: Privacy Policy and Terms of Use

variations.title: MORE VARIATIONS
variations.slogan: See how the design transforms with different initials, each variation, equally refined.

collections.descriptions: Explore our semi-custom collections: timeless designs crafted to make beauty feel simple, intentional, and deeply personal.
collections.slogan: Timeless beauty, crafted with calm and purpose.
collections.subTitle: From Start to Finish
collections.text: Our Semi-Custom Collections offer a refined and effortless way to create your stationery, without the complexity of a bespoke design. Each collection has its own distinctive style, colour palette, and layout — all you need to do is make it yours.
collections.result: A cohesive, timeless stationery suite, personalised with your story and ready to share with your guests.

steps.slogan1: Explore our range of semi-custom designs and choose the one that best reflects your style and the tone of your event.
steps.slogan2: Share your names, wording, dates, and any photos or personal text. The design remains as shown to preserve its visual harmony.
steps.slogan3: We’ll create a digital proof featuring your information within the chosen design. You’ll have the opportunity to review and confirm all details before printing.
steps.slogan4: Once approved, your suite is printed, assembled, and carefully packaged for delivery.

aboutUs.text1: VIOLET was born from the desire to simplify beauty, to make design feel effortless yet refined. We create semi-custom collections for those who value quiet elegance and thoughtful detail. Each piece is carefully designed to feel personal, intentional, and timeless.
aboutUs.text2: Founded by Inês Araujo Barros and Marta Garrido, VIOLET brings together a shared love for modern aesthetics and enduring design. We believe beauty should feel calm, balanced, and deeply connected to the story it tells.
aboutUs.title: About us
aboutUs.description: Created from a desire to make beauty feel effortless. Each design shaped with clarity, purpose, and quiet refinement.
aboutUs.ouMissionDescription: To craft refined, semi-custom collections that make elegance effortless. Each design is a balance of modern clarity and timeless grace, created with care and intention.
aboutUs.ourVisionDescription: To redefine simplicity, creating timeless designs that inspire calm, beauty, and purpose in every detail.
aboutUs.simplicityDescription: We believe less can say more.
aboutUs.authenticityDescription: Design that feels genuine, personal, and lasting.
aboutUs.slogan: We design not just for the moment, but for what remains.

monogram.title: monograms
monogram.description:
Personal detail, made simple.
Our semi-custom monograms combine modern design with subtle individuality, creating something that feels truly your own.
monogram.slogan: A symbol chosen to tell your story.
monogram.subTitle: From Start to Finish
monogram.text: Our Semi-Custom Monograms allow you to choose from a curated range of pre-designed monogram styles — refined, balanced, and ready to be made yours through your initials.
monogram.result: A timeless emblem that reflects your identity through considered design.

steps.slogan1: Browse our monogram collection and choose the style that best suits your aesthetic.
steps.slogan2: Share the letters to be featured in your chosen design. The composition, colours, and layout remain consistent to ensure visual harmony.
steps.slogan3: We’ll send a digital proof with your monogram applied for final approval.
steps.slogan4: Once confirmed, you’ll receive your monogram files, ready for use across your stationery, website, or printed materials.

website.title: Websites
website.description: An elegant foundation for your online presence, where design, purpose, and storytelling align effortlessly.
website.slogan: Elegant, functional, and ready to launch
website.subTitle: From Start to Finish
website.text: Our Semi-Custom Websites offer an elegant and efficient way to launch your online presence. Each template is pre-designed with a defined structure and aesthetic — you simply provide the content.
website.result: A beautifully cohesive website, designed, customised, and ready to share.

steps.slogan1: Select the website design that best fits your event or brand.
steps.slogan2: Provide your wording, photos, and any essential information. The layout and design remain as shown to maintain consistency.
steps.slogan3: We’ll customise the site with your content and share a live preview for approval.
steps.slogan4: Once approved, your site will be prepared for launch and made live under your chosen domain.

contactUs.text: If you have any questions or custom requests, we’re here to help.

contact.text: We’re glad to share suggestions that align with what you have in mind.
